scope: proposal SQL contract and server DML work only; no ObjectStore orchestration or report-envelope provenance pass

probes.name: proposal DDL rolls back and leaves the frozen main catalog untouched
manifest pins SQL-owned datasets, supported identities, DB clock and exact object metadata
real non-pipeline LOGIN cannot read/publish/enroll/guard or mutate any manifest table
ordinary pipeline credentials cannot forge clocks or directly change immutable identities
unsupported identities, backdated extra fields and mismatched mode/key/size are refused atomically
missing, invalidated, unsupported datasets and current withdrawn inputs refuse publication
CI server-side row writes are exact and identical for 0 and 2504 real dataset members
direct SQL publication rechecks current rights after an address lock wait
server work oracle observes hidden writes even when one client calls a definer function
rollback restores enrollment and removes all partially inserted manifest associations
guard alone preserves cleanup enrollment; unregistered audits are not claimed
committed references protect shared addresses and real pipeline grant has no role ownership
